'''Myōken-gū''' (妙見宮), '''Myōkendō''' (妙見堂), or '''Myōken Shrine''' (妙見神社) are [[Shinto shrine|Shinto shrine]] located in various regions of Japan. The enshrined deities are [[Ame-no-Minakanushi]] and the [[:en:North Star|North Star]].

* [[Myōken Shrine (Tokyo)]] - Located on [[Myōken Island]].
* [[Chiba Shrine]] - Located in [[Chūō-ku, Chiba|Chūō-ku, Chiba]], [[Chiba Prefecture|Chiba Prefecture]].
* [[Hoshida Myōkengū]] - Located in [[Katano|Katano]], [[Osaka Prefecture|Osaka Prefecture]].
* [[Iwaya Myōken-gū]] - Located in [[Nio-chō]], [[Mitoyo|Mitoyo]], [[Kagawa Prefecture|Kagawa Prefecture]].
* [[Myōken Shrine]] - Located in [[Muyachō Hayashizaki]], [[Naruto|Naruto]], [[Tokushima Prefecture|Tokushima Prefecture]].
* [[Myōken-gū (Tōyō)]] - Located in Shirahama, [[:en:Tōyō|Tōyō]], [[:en:Aki District|Aki District]], [[Kōchi Prefecture|Kōchi Prefecture]].
* [[Yatsushiro Shrine]] - Located in [[Yatsushiro|Yatsushiro]], [[Kumamoto Prefecture|Kumamoto Prefecture]].
* [[Mioya Shrine (Adachiyama Myōken-gū)]] - Located in [[:en:Kokurakita-ku|Kokurakita-ku]], [[Kitakyushu|Kitakyushu]], [[Fukuoka Prefecture|Fukuoka Prefecture]]. Since [[1945|1945]], also known as the General Myōken Shrine of Japan.
* Former name of [[Taga Shrine]] in [[Nogata|Nogata]].
* [[Katsuragi Shrine]] - Located in [[:en:Chikujō|Chikujō]], [[Chikujō District]], [[Fukuoka Prefecture|Fukuoka Prefecture]].
